audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart hands Dr. Mundo Level 6 and First item, while the packet chart and the content-layer win[] both give Mordekaiser every stage through First item. The two layers of the same page disagree.
audit.why: Realm of Death is the matchup's defining tool and it comes online at 6; one item of HP does not answer an isolation ult that steals stats. Winrate is 50.44 over 1826 games — even overall, decided by the late flip, not by a Level 6 flip.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group: Mordekaiser Levels 1 through First item, Dr. Mundo at 2+ items, matching the packet and the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Realm of Death is listed at 110s in breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].
audit.why: Riot data gives 140/120/100. At rank 1 that is a 140-second window, which changes how long the safe period actually is.
audit.corrected: Stated as 140s at rank 1, 100s at rank 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] calls Blunt Force Trauma (E) a dash. Mundo's E has range 0 and no movement component — it is an empowered attack reset. Also, the decisive interaction between Mundo's passive and Death's Grasp (E) is never stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Mundo's passive resists the first Immobilizing effect and drops a cannister. Mordekaiser's only lockdown in lane is the Death's Grasp pull (16/14/12/10/8s), so the passive is the direct counter to his engage — and once it is on cooldown his pull lands clean.
audit.corrected: E described as a non-dash attack reset; passive-vs-Death's Grasp interaction added to the level chart text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never ties Grievous Wounds to Indestructible, and spikes[3] spells the item 'Spirit Visor'.
audit.why: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken and converts the shield to a heal — the flagged missing interaction for this matchup. The item is Spirit Visage.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal reason stated in spikes[3]; item name corrected.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Realm of Death is up.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Obliterate hits harder on you alone and Indestructible banks that damage as a shield. Poke with Bonesaw, then leave Darkness Rise.

edits.before: Q ranks make the cleaver chunk real HP and your passive regen ramps. Mordekaiser must kill you through the sustain or watch you out-scale — most can't.
edits.after: Q ranks chunk real HP and your regen ramps, but Death's Grasp into Obliterate still wins the long trade. Your passive eats the first pull — then walk out.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force Mordekaiser to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: Realm of Death (140s at rank 1) drags you 1v1 and steals your stats — Maximum Dosage regen alone will not save it. Farm until it is spent, then step up.

edits.before: Heartsteel timing — every proc widens the HP gap and your cleavers start hurting. Stand in the wave and dare Mordekaiser to trade into the regen.
edits.after: Heartsteel widens the HP gap, but one item is not enough MR for the realm. Bait Realm of Death or fight with your jungler near, then trade into the regen.

edits.before: Extend through his passive — that is the exchange Mordekaiser wins flat.
edits.after: Extend inside Darkness Rise — that burn feeds Indestructible's shield.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death (110s): matchup-defining — His 1v1 isolation. While it’s down, you win. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death (140s at rank 1, 100s at rank 3): matchup-defining 1v1 isolation. While it’s down, you win. - Death's Grasp (16s at rank 1) is his only lockdown; your passive eats the first pull. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call.

edits.before: Track Mordekaiser’s Realm of Death (110s): His 1v1 isolation. While it’s down, you win. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Realm of Death (140s at rank 1): his 1v1 isolation, and your passive will not stop it. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: Morde's R Realm of Death drags you to the Death Realm 1v1 with no escape — E Blunt Force Trauma dash and R Maximum Dosage heal don't get you out. Inside, he steals your stats and beats a Mundo who can't run. Bait the ult with poke, or set up so his jungler shows and he can't safely commit the isolation ult.
edits.after: Morde's R Realm of Death drags you 1v1 with no escape — Blunt Force Trauma (E) is an attack reset, not a dash, and Maximum Dosage only delays him. Inside he steals your stats. It's 140s at rank 1: bait it with Bonesaw poke, count it down, and step up only once it's spent or his jungler is showing.

edits.before: Full build finally flips it: your enormous HP pool plus R Maximum Dosage out-heals his DoT, and once your MR is up (Spirit Visor) even his R can't kill you in the realm. Build magic resist first, dodge his Q, and you out-scale into the unkillable frontline he can't burst.
edits.after: Full build flips it: your HP pool plus Maximum Dosage (R) out-heals his DoT, and with Spirit Visage's MR and heal amp even Realm of Death can't kill you inside. Buy Grievous Wounds as well — Indestructible heals off the damage he deals, and that is what wins his long fights.

notes: Kit file flags Mordekaiser's Obliterate (Q) as 'grounding'. Riot's own description is only 'smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage' — no dash-denial text. Treated as a tooltip-parse misfire and NOT asserted anywhere in the rewrite. Owner-kit entry carries no ability names; Q/W/E/R names used (Infected Bonesaw, Heart Zapper, Blunt Force Trauma, Maximum Dosage) were already present in the page's existing text and were not introduced by this audit.
